ModMetaData.name: Deckie Dealer
ModMetaData.description:
A new storyteller, Deckie Dealer: a mixture of Cassandra's determinism and Randy's unpredictability.
Events are dealt from pre-generated per-category "decks" (event queues). Each deck cycle, a fixed number of event cards is shuffled across the timeline together with blank cards - so events are guaranteed to arrive within the cycle, but their exact timing is unpredictable.
Every deck-driven category can be tuned in the mod settings (interval length, events per interval, threat strength jitter, etc.), or switched off entirely to fall back to classic Cassandra-style generation for that category.
Default tuning matches full-DLC Cassandra's threat pressure while redistributing it: big threats swing between 1 and 3 per cycle with a guaranteed floor and minor threats match her rate. Quests match her Royalty rate and orbital traders arrive half again as often as hers - more trade and more opt-in quest offers to compensate the sharper threat spikes.
Source code: https://github.com/Riketta/DeckStoryteller
